recipe.visualDefinition: A highly symmetrical 1970s-style layout featuring a central square portrait frame containing two mirrored profile shots of a subject, one upright and one inverted. The composition is anchored by large, stylized display text at the top and bottom, with the bottom text being a 180-degree rotation of the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Rotational symmetry between top and bottom typographic blocks
Internal mirroring of the central photographic subject
High contrast between the off-white background and deep red/brown tones
Tight framing of the central square within a large negative space border
coreInvariants: Off-white or cream-colored paper texture background
Central square frame with a solid border
Inverted mirroring of both text and image elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central square frame occupying approximately 40% of the total area, containing two profile portraits facing each other.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central square frame with its bold red border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down to the central portrait, then follows the inverted text at the bottom, creating a circular reading motion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial off-white margins surrounding the central frame and separating the text blocks.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty Pink (Specific letters in display text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm saturation typical of 1970s print media; low-key lighting in the photography.

letterConstructionRules: Ball terminals on specific characters like 'O' and 'T'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' features a decorative ball terminal flourish inside the counter
The letter 'T' has a curved, swash-like crossbar

composition.position: Between display text and central frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast decorative serif for main titles paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, condensed serif look with vintage flair.
Captures the extreme contrast and ball terminals of 70s display type.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1970s album cover background on cream-colored paper. In the center, place a square frame with a thick deep red border. Inside the frame, show two profile portraits of a person with a short afro hairstyle; the left portrait is upright, and the right portrait is inverted 180 degrees so they appear to be looking at each other from opposite orientations. Use warm, low-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large display title in a high-contrast serif font at the top, centered. Add a smaller sans-serif subtitle below it. Duplicate both text blocks, rotate them 180 degrees, and place them at the bottom of the composition to create perfect rotational symmetry.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text perfectly inverted?
Does the central frame have a distinct red border?
Is the background a warm, off-white cream color?
Are the portraits inside the frame oriented in opposite directions?

mustRedesign: Specific logos or record label marks
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for 180-degree rotation of bottom elements
Ensure the central frame is a perfect square
Verify the high-contrast serif font has ball terminals
Confirm the color palette is limited to warm, muted tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central square image, mirror it vertically and horizontally within the frame, then frame the entire composition with large, high-contrast serif text that is duplicated and rotated 180 degrees at the bottom.
